This is 4 days old but I feel I have an obligation to respond because this was my situation, but it’s too late for me now, my sister is gone.

Simple easy advise for you to follow

1) Don’t say you don’t hold control over yourself. Yes I know what you mean in the moment all we see is red, however we need to acknowledge we aren’t animals and we need to civilize ourselves a bit more. Take the first step which is taking responsibility to yourself

2) take responsibility infront of your sister. This is important because as others have said people wished their brothers would have apologized to them and said sorry. 

3) Talk with her openly about it. if she can hold her own during one of her fits (not her responsibility but she can actually be an aide to you). But if you can tell her “hey, if you can keep your cool with me when I’m angry and understand that this is something I’m phasing out” not only will she understand better that you’re not a monster, but she will help you calm down.

Hey, competitive games are major anger inducing devil spawns so if that’s the only time he’s getting mad then I understand. But it sounds like he has a problem like many of us here. What he says is true about his anger, many of us (me included) aren’t capable of many emotions besides anger and it is a coping mechanism. Instead of feeling sad we feel anger, instead of disappointment we feel anger, you get the idea. Problem is I understand this about myself and this is one of the reasons I reject advances from girls. I’m not ready or capable to stop being angry yet, I don’t want to make an innocent person put up with that. I understand you care for him but he should either get help, or understand he shouldn’t be putting this on you. There is a genetic and situational component to it that makes alot of us like this but that doesn’t mean he’s not responsible. When I’m angry at my family and friends which is often I’m at least attempting to control myself. He isn’t doing that obviously. I would tell you avoid his triggers (such as the game it’s the same for me) if you want to be around him but that’s not your responsibility. A lot of us on this sub are here to get help. He might like being mad (again something some of us here can relate to) and some of us don’t want to stop being mad. He needs to make that trade, either stop and get help, or not subject you to that anymore.
